commits.summary: Record verification results for 10 jobs: examples 150 to 152 pass, 147 to 149, 160 and 161 still fail, VF-009 triaged
commits.body: Run on vm-1 with 3 workers and 20 GiB. Passed: examples 150, 151, 152 (close VF-017), and the VF-009 triage (evidence that stock JBMC does not wrap a class initializer's throw: it fails wrapped, erroneous, once, enumWrapped, boomTwice and enumBroken, as the JVM does not). Failed: examples 147, 148 and 149 at 'apply the patch' (the crosscut Tests.java context changed; VF-002 updated), examples 160 and 161 at the result schema, which lacks scope.proofCache (VF-016 updated), and VF-010's reproducer, which exits 1 because all 8 runs found the violation in 3 to 5 s on vm-1, so the problem did not reproduce here (VF-010 updated). VF-020 is new: a 1.2 MiB changes.diff of the triage job is not committed because jj refuses to snapshot it. Verified by: collect's output, the jobs' logs, and git apply --check of the three patches against the current tree.

commits.summary: Record verification results for 22 jobs: VF-009, VF-010, VF-016, VF-017 and VF-019 closed
commits.body: Run on vm-1 with 4 workers and 28 GiB. Closed: VF-019 and VF-009 (the conformance corpus and the extra-initializers jobs pass, the guard job shows no recorded JBMC example lost), VF-016 (examples 160 and 161 as expected), VF-017 (150 to 152, earlier), VF-010 (the reproducer 8 of 8 alike and 64 integration tests at the fix). Passed with results applied: example 149 and 160 and 161. Still open and updated: VF-018 (prices.Prices#total passes under JBMC at 1800 s, the other three still time out), VF-015 (example 109 now stops at the --gaps strict refusal of String.format), VF-002 (147 and 148 fail in stage_contracts, the gaps.contracts is read from the attempt directory; 149 passes), VF-001 (the two conformance jobs lack mkdir -p target before tee, so they fail although the tests pass), VF-014 (the two isolated benchmark runs pass, comparison pending). New: VF-021 (VF-010's two benchmark jobs got SIGTERM). VF-020 remains: the 1.2 MiB changes.diff is not committed. Verified by: collect output and the jobs' logs.

commits.summary: VF-020: a second oversized changes.diff left out of the results
commits.body: The guard job 20261107-171442-vf-009-s-guard-measured-the-41-recorded also has a 1.3 MiB changes.diff that jj refuses to snapshot; recorded in verification/findings.md.

commits.summary: Record verification results for 3 jobs: VF-014 closed, VF-010's benchmark pair recorded, and the runner's scope names made unique
commits.body: Run on vm-1. Job 20261107-183328 (VF-014's comparison) passed with 'verdicts changed: 0' and closes VF-014. The resubmitted VF-010 benchmark pair passed (3m11s each), outputs applied; the verdict comparison is still to be queued by the native stream, so VF-021 stays open. The pipeline fix: the runner named a step's systemd scope vjob-<id[:40]>-<step>, so two jobs whose ids share 40 characters stopped each other's steps with SIGTERM; verification/pipeline.py now uses scope_id(), the first 30 characters and a hash of the whole id. That was also the cause of one VF-001 job's SIGTERM, noted there. Verified by loading pipeline.py and checking that the two colliding ids of that pair give different names, and by the pair's passing without a collision.

commits.summary: Draft the application-core loop: four streams that widen native change verification to ordinary service code
commits.body:
Adds llm-dlc/loops/application-core.md, its four stream briefs (objects, values, environment, reuse) and application-core-acceptance.md, adapted from an outside plan the user shared (a review of the repository at cbf183a on GitHub). Each of the review's claims about the code was recounted at wwlnosom (20f1a17d), with file:line evidence, in the main brief's 'Where it starts from'. All held, and one sharpened: ObjectDomain's made_by, classes, allocations and label are read by nothing outside the cache key's projection, so Phase 0's first step is a gate that refuses them. The briefs follow brief-template.md: the cleanup run's pipeline mode, the timebox, application-core-STREAM workspaces, reserved example ranges 230-279, 4 GB scopes, fresh session ids, and the planning session 3da21514 as the fork. Shared files get a single writer (Phase 0, before the fork), because the foundations and cleanup integration checks both stopped on merge conflicts. The six decisions are proposed, not yet settled by the user.

Also registers the names application-core and application-core-STREAM in feature-loop.sh (refusing application-core-acceptance, which is not a brief), and application-core with its four streams in run-streams.sh. Adds llm-dlc/tools/application-core-integration.sh, which tells a compile failure, a failure of the integration contract lib/tests/application_core.rs (written in Phase 0) and other test failures apart. Both scripts were replaced by rename, because run-streams.sh cleanup was running from this workspace and bash reads a running script incrementally. Checked with bash -n and by resolving the four names through feature-loop.sh's case. Not launched: the cleanup merge, Phase 0 and the user's decisions come first.
